sentences: The problem tt-DT concerns decision-tree complexity when a Boolean function is supplied through its truth table.
The saved question asks for the exact time complexity of this meta-computational task.
The truth table makes all function values available but does not reveal the best adaptive query strategy directly.
Determining the complexity would clarify how difficult it is to optimize a computation when its complete input-output behavior is explicit.
The excerpt does not specify whether the task computes an optimum or decides a threshold, nor the requested precision of the running-time bound, so the source must supply those conventions.
